This is expected/documented — flagging so main agent conveys to user before demo.

critical_code_review_comments: use-stop-notification.ts:29-36 setNotificationHandler is called at module top-level (not inside the hook) — correct: it must register once before any notification fires. shouldShowBanner:false + shouldShowList:true means the notification will still appear in the notification tray/lock-screen when backgrounded but never as a foreground banner, matching Circuit behavior the user requested.

use-stop-notification.ts:121-137 first useEffect keeps currentStopRef in sync with the pendente stop AND dismisses when no pendente exists — this handles the 'route complete' case (item vi of STATIC #2) elegantly.

use-stop-notification.ts:146-161 AppState listener only fires scheduleNotificationAsync on active→background transition and dismissNotificationAsync on background→active — no wasted work on same-state transitions.
use-stop-notification.ts:163-167 cleanup calls sub.remove() AND dismissNotification() on unmount — good hygiene; prevents ghost notifications when user logs out.

use-stop-notification.ts:38-53 setNotificationChannelAsync uses AndroidImportance.LOW + vibrationPattern:[0] + enableVibrate:false — silent sticky notification, exactly what a delivery driver needs (no beeping every stop).
use-stop-notification.ts:78-84 body construction breaks endereco on commas and puts 'Código: XXX' on its own line — matches user spec of 'address, house number, and delivery code'.
route.tsx:60 usePersistentStopNotification(stops) is called at top level of the component, before any early return — safe under Rules of Hooks. Same for scanner.tsx:40.

route.tsx:294-303 Reotimizar Alert uses [kmStr, timeStr].filter(Boolean).join(' • ') — defensive against missing metrics (if m is null, both strings are '' and only the paradas count line renders). Nice touch.

app.json:54-59 expo-notifications plugin declared with only 'color' prop — no icon set (icon defaults to app icon). Fine for MVP; main agent may want to add a dedicated monochrome notification icon per Android Material guidelines later.
Both route.tsx and scanner.tsx wire the same hook with the local `stops` state — so the currently-visible stop set drives the notification regardless of which screen is active. Consistent.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only — 87-stop optimize payload uses random.seed(1234) for reproducibility; no DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 reused /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py (identical checklist for backend items #8-11). To run: `export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2); pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py -v`. Static hook verification is sufficient for iterations 11+.
